ENGINE MECHANICAL — Cylinder Head

(c) Coat all bearing journals with engine oil.
(d) Place the camshafts on the cylinder head as shown in the illustration.
HINT: The exhaust camshaft has a distributor (7M-GE) or cam position sensor (7M-GTE) drive gear.

(e) Apply seal packing to the areas indicated in the illustration.
Seal packing: Part No.08826-00080 or equivalent
HINT: Install the No.1 bearing cap immediately after applying the seal packing.

2 – 3 mm
(0.08 – 0.12 in.)

I: Intake
E: Exhaust

No. 2 – No. 7

Front Mark

I: Intake
E: Exhaust

(f) Place bearing caps on each journal with the front marks pointing toward the front and in numerical order from the front side.

7    6    5    4    3    5    2    1

(g) Temporarily install the bearing cap bolts in the several passes in the sequence shown.

SST

(h) Using SST, tap in the camshaft oil seal.
SST 09223-50010
HINT: Be careful not to install the oil seal slantwise.
